name: oas4_h3_igcraft_t1
endpoint: Framework-averaged native edit similarity; length, diversity, conditional recovery and judge scores are supporting.
limits: Sensitivity analysis of the IgCraft arm: identical to oas4_h3_igcraft except that IgCraft's temperature is 1.0, the value the neural arms use, instead of its documented inpainting default of 0.1. Reported descriptively; it is not part of the planned contrast family.

IgCraft receives heavy-chain IMGT flank regions only: CDR3 and the whole light chain are masked, pads included (fix_length false). Its step, particle and temperature settings are its documented inpainting defaults, not the matched neural sampling budget.
IgCraft has about 300M parameters and its pretraining exposure to these OAS donors is unverified; its CDR3 slot holds 30 residues.
Judge sees heavy chain only in every arm; scores are reused from the finished eight-arm comparison only if the judge revision and policy match.
